simple.inThisVerse: The selected word is tied to דׇּפִי (H1848) in the Hebrew source text. Part of speech: n-m.
simple.whyItMatters: This word is connected to the original Hebrew source text, so BibleIQ can explain it from the underlying word rather than only the English translation.
simple.summary: דׇּפִי (dophîy) means a stumbling-block First listed occurrence: Ps 50 20.

definitions.full: H1848. dophi [ דֳּפִי ] noun [masculine] blemish, fault תִּתֶּןֿדֹּפִי׃ בְּבֶןאִֿמְּךָ Psa 50:20 against thy mother's son thou dost allege a fault (|| תְדַבֵּ֑ר בְּאָחִיךָ ).
definitions.rootNote: from an unused root (meaning to push over);
